other_failure_modes.name: Hardcoded submission IDs
other_failure_modes.description: The agent generates the submission file using `np.arange` for the 'id' column instead of extracting and using the actual IDs from the test dataset. This will cause evaluation to fail or mismatch predictions if the test set IDs are non-sequential or do not start from 0.

other_failure_modes.name: Train/Test feature mismatch due to dynamic column selection
other_failure_modes.description: In the text extraction helper, the agent filters columns to concatenate based on a dynamic condition (`mean length > 3`) applied to the currently passed dataframe. Since this is applied independently to train and test, different columns may be selected for concatenation if a column is populated in train but mostly empty in test.

other_failure_modes.name: Feature aggregation before CV splitting
other_failure_modes.description: The agent computes grouped statistics (mean, median, std) for numerical features over the entire training set before performing cross-validation. This causes an unsupervised validation leak, as the validation fold's feature values influence the aggregated statistics seen during model training.

summary: Overall, the agent provides a highly sophisticated and structurally sound data science solution with excellent feature engineering, robust OOF target encoding, and an optimized ensemble. However, it introduces a critical failure by hardcoding sequential IDs in the final submission instead of using the provided test IDs. Additionally, there are moderate issues with dynamic column selection causing train/test feature mismatches, and minor validation leakage from aggregating features before cross-validation.
